notes: Adds API/UI surface, persistence contract, tests, and cross-service integration coverage for consent workflow.

change_log.value: Consent persistence schema and storage contract
Consent API endpoints and tool exposure
Consent workflow unit and integration tests

stories.title: Consent Persistence Schema and Storage Contract
stories.description: Define and implement MongoDB schema and storage contract for consent records including tier level, timestamp, session linkage, and audit fields. Ensure compatibility with existing debug logger and lead storage patterns.

stories.title: Consent API Endpoints and Tool Router Exposure
stories.description: Expose consent workflow via FastAPI endpoints and register tool definitions in tool_router for LLM-triggered consent capture and upgrade flows, including validation through Pydantic models.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating tier enforcement, de-identification behavior, API responses, and failure cases including invalid transitions and missing consent.

stories.title: Cross-Service Consent Enforcement Integration
stories.description: Integrate consent enforcement into unknown question handling and safety services to ensure no identifiable data is persisted or processed without appropriate consent tier across all shared services.
